_comment: Every entry here IS a hole: a step gated on the artefact whose absence is
the defect the step exists to catch. They are listed rather than fixed
because each is owned by an in-flight change on the same subsystem, and
silently allowlisting them would recreate exactly the invisibility this
flow_condition_reachability_check.py FAILs on any hole NOT listed here, and
ALSO FAILs when a listed entry is no longer a hole. A fix must therefore
delete its baseline entry in the same change — the file cannot rot into a
Do not add to this file to make a build green. Add to it only with an
owner, and only when the fix genuinely belongs in another change.
_closed: DT3 (vibe-ic#235 cascade) — CLOSED by declaring DT1's and DT2's coverage reports as each step's SOLE single-branch required_output. DT3's two trigger paths are now T3 BACKSTOP: if either upstream grade vanishes, the step that owns it goes MISSING loudly, so DT3's disappearance is no longer silent. NOT closed by this: the flow-level non-fatal verdict for 'ran, disclosed, could not measure' that the DT2 entry still waits on — DT3's condition was NOT armed on the disclosure record, exactly as the note measured it must not be.

DT2 (vibe-ic#235) — CLOSED 2026-08-31 by resolving the CONDITION, not by re-labelling it. The entry's own note said closing it needed a flow-level non-fatal 'ran, disclosed, could not measure' verdict first. That premise followed from trying to ARM the condition on a disclosure record, which does need such a verdict; the guard was never asking for an extra arm. `classify()` named exactly two of the three ALL-of paths as unreachable — `phase2/stage2/dft/cut_netlist.v` and `phase3/stage3/pnr/*_pnr.v` — and left `phase3/stage3/extracted/*.spef` alone, because it already carries a T3 backstop as step 22's sole required_output. Both unreachable paths are artefacts a producer really writes that no step in the flow YAML declares, so their absence is loud nowhere. The condition is now the two DECLARED artefacts of this step's own `blocks_on: [DT1, 22]`: DT1's sole required_output `reports/phase2/dft/transition_coverage.json` plus step 22's `phase3/stage3/extracted/*.spef`. DT3 one step later already used this spelling. DECLARING THE TWO INSTEAD WAS MEASURED AND REFUSED: `*_pnr.v` is absent from 29 of 41 published routed run roots, so a hard files_exist at step 21 would newly fail 29 shipped cells; and a step-11 hard `any_of` of cut_netlist.v OR dft_atpg_not_run.json fails a real run root (37 of 491 dft dirs carry scan_netlist.v with neither, `_scan/T1` among them). TWO-ARM MEASUREMENT, 8 fixtures + 3 real run roots, single-step DT2 flow: `pre_route` unchanged at SKIPPED-CONDITION (the 2026-07-28 withdrawal's regression case does NOT recur — removing paths from an ALL-of can only arm the condition later, never earlier); a routed+extracted design with NO DFT still self-skips (no false alarm); two silent skips became MISSING rc 1; nothing went PASS -> FAIL; and benchmark-data/ic/spm/v1.5.58_ihp-sg13g2 — a published cell holding a real 16-of-16 robust at-speed PASS that the old condition discarded — now reports that PASS. The full prior adjudication is preserved verbatim in `_closed_detail` below rather than deleted with the entry.

DT2.owner: vibe-ic#235 — PRODUCER + CONSUMER halves LANDED; flow-YAML wire STILL BLOCKED on a missing non-fatal flow verdict. RESTORED 2026-07-28 at convergence merge: the dimension-6 attempt to close it by re-arming DT2 on its own producer's outputs was measured to be a REGRESSION and was withdrawn — see this entry's note.
DT2.note: Same shape as DT1 and strictly worse: the condition is ALL-of, so ANY one of the three inputs going missing disarms the step. STATUS (vibe-ic#235): the PRODUCER half is DONE — phase3_one_shot_runner.run_at_speed_atpg_producers writes `phase2/stage2/dft/path_delay_atpg_not_run.json` on every self-disable branch (precondition_unmet / producer_wrote_no_artifact / producer_execution_error) and DELETES it once a real grade exists. The CONSUMER half is DONE — path_delay_coverage_check now reads that record and answers BLOCKED (rc 1, still not a pass) with the recorded reason, instead of a bare FAIL that cannot tell 'never ran' from 'ran and could not measure'. This stays a hole because the REMAINING — and NOT the edit this note previously prescribed. It said to add the disclosure path to condition.files_exist with `any_of: true`, and called that safe because the BLOCKED branch had landed. MEASURED, that edit BREAKS the flow: `flow_compliance_check` has no BLOCKED verdict (its set is PASS/FAIL/MISSING/SKIPPED-CONDITION/SKIPPED-SETUP-REQUIRED/DEFERRED-BY-UPSTREAM/VACUOUS-PASS/WAIVED-DEFERRED) and the consumer returns rc 1 for BLOCKED exactly as it does for FAIL. Arming the condition therefore flips this step from SKIPPED-CONDITION to a hard FAIL on EVERY design that has a cut netlist and has not yet routed — strictly worse than the silent skip it was meant to cure. Closing this entry needs a FLOW-LEVEL non-fatal verdict for 'ran, disclosed, could not measure' first; until that exists the disclosure record is the fix and this entry stays open by design.  |  RESTORED 2026-07-28. A dimension-6 change replaced this ALL-of condition with an any-of over the PRODUCER'S OWN OUTPUTS (reports/phase2/dft/path_delay_coverage.json OR phase2/stage2/dft/path_delay_atpg_not_run.json). Measured on a copy of a tracked run root with ONE mutation — delete reports/phase2/dft/path_delay_coverage.json, the artefact DT2 exists to report on: with the ALL-of condition the step goes MISSING and the flow verdict is FAIL (rc 1); with the producer-outputs condition the step goes SKIPPED-CONDITION, leaves the executed-PASS denominator (total_required subtracts SKIPPED-CONDITION) and the flow verdict is PASS (rc 0). That trades an input-side self-disable for an output-side one and is strictly worse, because the producer never running is a production-reachable state (run_at_speed_atpg_producers lives inside step_canonicalize_artefacts, which a routing FAIL that returns early from step_pnr skips) and path_delay_atpg_not_run.json exists in 0 of the 12 tracked run roots. The condition is back to the ALL-of spelling and this entry is a hole again.
